player_0.content: New plan: I failed to recognize that the Exercise room was a dead end and prematurely issued "DONE" without checking for unvisited neighbors. Next time, when I enter a room with only one available direction (like Exercise room with only "north"), I will immediately attempt to go that way to verify if it leads to a new room. If that direction leads back to a previously visited room or a dead end, I will then check if I have visited all other reachable rooms before deciding to stop. I will maintain a mental list of visited rooms to ensure I do not stop until every possible room has been entered.
